author: dAN Hartke
title: Like everything else…
content:
I got roped into another one! All of these games are the same: 
- base building (that really amounts to nothing), 
- endless “rewards” or upgrades that are really just to get you to click and feel the little thrill of getting something, 
- battles you watch play out (again, everything levels up with you, so it amounts to watching the same thing over and over), 
- a storyline (I didn’t ask for) that’s not interesting. 

when you do control “the action”, you play for about 30-45 seconds, shoot 3 enemies, sometimes, and you’re done. Back to clicking boxes and leveling up things you don’t even know what they do! 

I really wanted to snipe things! That was the add. They should put in the add that you’re going to spend most of your time building a base, like every other base building game.

If you love base building, this is a good game. Checks all the boxes! If you want to snipe things, keep looking.

author: Q45moh2
title: Bait and Switch Disaster
content:
If it was a sniper game, it would be OK. But it’s not a sniper game. It has sniping. But mostly it’s a base and army management game. Which would also be cool because it has a lot to do and has a lot of leader characters that you can collect. And it has a lot of different activities to keep you engaged. It has a rudimentary storyline where it mixes up the different types of combat. And it also has several different ways that you can choose to advance your characters. Like giving them different parts for their equipment.
That all sounds really good and it is, till you hit level eight with your main base
Apparently unbeknownst to you for the first seven levels of your main base you are under an unbreakable dome
As soon as your base hits level eight, you are open to being attacked by other online players. 
The problem is the game itself is fun, but in order to progress in a lot of ways to form alliances with other online players. If you just wanted to kick back with a cool war game and play by yourself, that’s not really an option to get the best out of it. But the idea that as soon as you put your phone down, you’re getting relentlessly attacked by Members of the online community who are stealing your hard earned resources. That sealed it to doom
Soon as I logged in to see most of my money gone I uninstalled the app right away. Good for about two days of fun single player play after that might as well take it off your phone
And don’t bother linking all your accounts and giving you your email and sacrificing all your info right before you do it either. like the title says bait and switch
